CameraAccess.description: How a camera stream can be reached, if there is one.
CameraAccess.title: CameraAccess

ConnectionKind.description: How the Device-Gateway is connected to the mower.
ConnectionKind.title: ConnectionKind

DriveSpeedSetting.description:
The vendor's speed setting for manual driving, as far as the connection can change it
(``MowerCapabilities.drive_speed_setting``): the accepted range and step in m/s.
DriveSpeedSetting.title: DriveSpeedSetting

ObstacleDetection.description:
How eagerly the mower avoids obstacles during a native job (``MowPattern``).

Which modes a mower offers depends on its model and firmware
(``MowerCapabilities.start_options.obstacle_detection``). The names follow the vendor apps:
``off`` is the plain bump-and-turn behaviour, ``standard`` avoids obstacles it sees ahead,
``sensitive`` additionally avoids areas that are not lawn; ``slow_touch`` and
``less_touch`` exist only on older firmware.
ObstacleDetection.title: ObstacleDetection

PathOrder.description: Whether the border laps run before or after the fill of a native job.
PathOrder.title: PathOrder

RtkSource.description: Where RTK correction data comes from.
RtkSource.title: RtkSource

SettingGroup.description: Where a client shows a setting.
SettingGroup.title: SettingGroup

SettingSpec.description: One setting a mower has, as its connection declares it (``MowerCapabilities.settings``).

key.description: Manufacturer-neutral key, one of the known keys.
key.title: Key

options.description: The options of an `enum` setting, in the order a client offers them.
options.title: Options

step.description: Grid of an `int` setting, counted from `min`.
step.title: Step

unit.description: Unit of an `int` setting, e.g. `%` or `h`.
unit.title: Unit

SettingSpec.title: SettingSpec

SettingType.description: The type of a setting's value.
SettingType.title: SettingType

StartOptions.description:
The job options a native start may carry besides the pattern (``MowPattern``), as one
mower declares them (ADR 0030 amendment of 2026-10-24).

Everything defaults to "not offered": a client shows an option only when it is declared
here, and the connection refuses a start that sets an option it does not declare. An option
a start leaves out (None) is not sent, so the mower keeps its own default.

obstacle_detection.description: Obstacle detection modes the mower offers, in the order a client shows them (`MowPattern.obstacle_detection`); empty when it offers no choice.
obstacle_detection.title: Obstacle Detection

obstacle_laps_range.description: Inclusive (min, max) laps around each no-go zone (`MowPattern.obstacle_laps`), if settable.
obstacle_laps_range.title: Obstacle Laps Range

orders.description: Path orders the mower offers (`MowPattern.order`); empty when it offers no choice.
orders.title: Orders

start_progress_range_pct.description: Inclusive (min, max) progress in percent a job may start at (`MowPattern.start_progress_pct`), if settable.
start_progress_range_pct.title: Start Progress Range Pct

StartOptions.title: StartOptions

StartPlan.description:
One way to start a mower that has no map areas to choose (ADR 0066 amendment).

A mower whose connection knows no area geometry (its vendor keeps the garden to itself)
cannot be started by tapping areas. Its connection declares the starts it offers instead; a
client sends ``StartMow {plan_ref: ref}`` for the one the user picks and labels it by
``kind`` (plus ``name`` for a zone).

name.description: The mower's own name of a zone, shown as is; null for the other kinds.
name.title: Name

StartPlan.title: StartPlan

StartPlanKind.description: What a start plan does, so a client can label it without knowing the vendor.
StartPlanKind.title: StartPlanKind

description:
Feature flags and limits of one mower behind one connection.

All fields default to "not supported", so an adapter only declares what it really offers.

base_station_firmware_update.description: The connection can ask the manufacturer's firmware service for the linked RTK base station and install its updates (`firmware_check` with target `base_station`, `base_station_firmware_update`; ADR 0047).
base_station_firmware_update.title: Base Station Firmware Update

blade_height_range_mm.description: Inclusive (min, max) blade height in millimetres, if settable.
blade_height_range_mm.title: Blade Height Range Mm

connection_kinds.description: Connection kinds this mower can use.
connection_kinds.title: Connection Kinds

custom_paths.description: The mower can follow an arbitrary path or boundary.
custom_paths.title: Custom Paths

cutting_width_mm.description: Width of the cut swath in millimetres, if known (coverage heatmaps).
cutting_width_mm.title: Cutting Width Mm

drive_reverse.description: The drive link that carries the joystick frames can drive backwards (a negative `ManualDrive.linear`). Without it the web joystick offers no reverse and a spot run's `multi_point` turns fall back to `arc` (ADR 0043).
drive_reverse.title: Drive Reverse

drive_speed_setting.description: The vendor's speed setting for manual driving can be read (`MowerState.drive_speed_mps`) and changed (`set_drive_speed`) within this range; null when the connection cannot (ADR 0042).

firmware_update.description: The connection can ask the manufacturer's firmware service for updates and install them (`firmware_check`, `firmware_update`).
firmware_update.title: Firmware Update

light.description: The mower's light (e.g. the camera's headlamp) can be switched with `set_light`.
light.title: Light

links_supported.description: Additional link kinds this connection can open next to its primary one (e.g. `ble_bridge`); empty when the mower has only its primary connection.
links_supported.title: Links Supported

maintenance.description: Maintenance commands this connection can send (ADR 0048): `restart_mower`, `sync_map`, `relocate_dock`, `leave_dock` (only together with `undock`), `resync_rtk`. Clients offer only these; empty when the connection has none.
maintenance.title: Maintenance

manual_drive_blades.description: Blades may run during manual driving when a frame explicitly asks for it.
manual_drive_blades.title: Manual Drive Blades

max_speed_mps.description: Highest settable driving speed while mowing.
max_speed_mps.title: Max Speed Mps

min_speed_mps.description: Lowest settable driving speed while mowing, if the model has one.
min_speed_mps.title: Min Speed Mps

native_patterns.description: Mowing pattern names the mower runs natively on its own map areas, for example `stripes`, `diagonal`, `checkerboard`, `edge_only`.
native_patterns.title: Native Patterns

path_spacing_range_mm.description: Inclusive (min, max) distance between neighbouring mowing paths in millimetres (`MowPattern.spacing_m`), if the model has a settable spacing.
path_spacing_range_mm.title: Path Spacing Range Mm

rtk_sources.description: RTK correction sources the mower can report.
rtk_sources.title: Rtk Sources

settings.description: The mower's own settings this connection can read and change with `set_setting` (ADR 0046), each with its type and range or options; current values in `MowerState.settings`. Empty when the connection offers none.
settings.title: Settings

start_options.description: Job options a native start may carry besides the pattern (obstacle detection, laps around no-go zones, path order, start progress; ADR 0030). Clients show only what is declared here.

start_plans.description: Starts the mower offers without map areas (ADR 0066 amendment), in the order a client lists them; each is sent as `StartMow.plan_ref`. Empty for mowers that start on their map areas.
start_plans.title: Start Plans

undock.description: The connection can make the mower leave its charging station by itself (`leave_dock`), so a spot run may start from the dock (ADR 0041).
undock.title: Undock

title: MowerCapabilities
